notes: «أبيه» is a bare kinship word: relation link, the father is not named in the text
«فقال لنا رجل من مزينة» is explicit transmission: the man from Muzaynah, a Companion who was on the journey, is an unnamed last link before the Prophet's saying
«في حديثه عن أبي الأحوص» is the route itself, not a remark
